actions.title: Ask Snake River Memory for a legible wafer fab statement and a signed US origin declaration
actions.why: Moving the LPDDR5X award to Snake River Memory saves $3,364,000 a year, but only once we can show the wafers were fabricated in the US.
actions.draft_email:
Hello M. Alvarez,

Thank you for certificate SRM-CoC-11873 covering lots SRM-2611-A and SRM-2611-B of LK-DR-12 (SRM SR5X12G-85).

The wafer fab line is unreadable on the copy we received. Could you send:
1. A legible copy of the certificate showing the wafer fabrication site.
2. A signed origin declaration naming the wafer fab for LK-DR-08 and LK-DR-12.

We need both before we can place volume orders under quotation Q-SRM-2611.

Thank you,
Maya Chen
Sourcing, Larkspur Mobile, Inc.

actions.title: Ask Lone Star Silicon to quote the power management IC
actions.why: LK-PM-01 from Kaohsiung Power Devices now carries $372,000 a year in added duty. A part fabricated in the US would carry none.
actions.draft_email:
Hello,

We are looking for a second source for our power management IC, LK-PM-01, at about 800,000 units a year, starting in the second quarter of 2027.

Could you quote unit price, lead time and the wafer fab location? We can share the data sheet under NDA.

Thank you,
Maya Chen
Sourcing, Larkspur Mobile, Inc.
